mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_question_source WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_question_source SET question_id=#{questionId},source_id=#{sourceId},question_no=#{questionNo},page_from=#{pageFrom},page_to=#{pageTo},score=#{score},match_status=#{matchStatus},matched_stem_hash=#{matchedStemHash},evidence_asset_id=#{evidenceAssetId},verification_note=#{verificationNote},verified_at=#{verifiedAt},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW(),remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_source WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND question_no=#{questionNo} AND page_from=#{pageFrom} AND COALESCE(page_to,page_from)=COALESCE(#{pageTo},#{pageFrom}) AND id != #{id}

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id) AS (SELECT parent_question_id FROM kb_question_derivation WHERE child_question_id=#{id} UNION DISTINCT SELECT d.parent_question_id FROM kb_question_derivation d JOIN ancestors a ON a.id=d.child_question_id) SELECT qs.* FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN ancestors a ON a.id=qs.question_id
